# What to do

**The level.** This page is a policy reading of the study, not a fifth lemma. It sits on L1–L4, sim1–sim6 and emp2. If it diverges from them, it is wrong.

**The decision.** Fix the pool formula if you must stay in World A — four steps, all computed. Change the cash register anyway: the unit of value is the fan, not the play. What used to be a royalty becomes the price of a thing — a drop, a ticket, patronage. Tonify is the wedge; Unify is the rail.
